subject: english
question:
Two figures given on the left side of (::) are related with some logic/rule/relation. Select the missing figure on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same logic/rule/relation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae2765a2ade7f4b11973cdbbe77b464027492dd7081eab4c54dbce45e7fb081b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The number of internal symbols determines the sides of the resulting shape inside the square.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/108d82bac1be37807a6652dfe7d595eeff15c50b3cc074212b4d023d02092e69.png] 

Analysis of the Figures:

**First Pair:** Square with 4 asterisks → Related figure: square inside a square (4 sides).

**Second Pair:** Square with 5 horizontal lines → Related figure: pentagon inside the square (5 sides).

Option Check:

Option 1 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6479139b76843a7cfd61c71c4f03e8c17edc57e91a8551c16e48a63c3de782ec.png] 

– Square (4 sides) 

Option 2 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c9cb56633932e7e012df9ed90c7c7ab1d07ae1be7a5e0aebd9f030242865537.png] 

– Triangle (3 sides) 

**Option 3 ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8039fdf66df06fef6605ae1dcf292046c8bd6304130bef600092fe8bdb1a95e.png] 

– Pentagon (5 sides) 

Option 4 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12310128d9fa90173ea55b97eca4f78aab534c45f7a03d90803a7863a800e60f.png] 

– Right-angled triangle (3 sides) 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
